description: Test CORS misconfigurations: origin reflection, null origin trust, subdomain wildcards. Sends requests with various Origin headers and checks Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials in the response. Misconfigurations allow attacker sites to read authenticated API responses. Returns: {results: [{test, origin_sent, acao, acac, vulnerable}], exploit_html}. Side effects: Read-only requests with custom Origin headers. Sends ~8 requests.

api_endpoint.description: API endpoint to test CORS on, e.g. /api/account or /api/users/me

auth_cookie.description: Session cookie to include for authenticated CORS tests

url.description: Base URL of the target application, e.g. https://target.com

name: cors_test
